SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
MONDAY - APRIL 20, 2020 -
02:00 P.M.
TELECONFERENCE MEETING AUTHORIZED BY STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20 VIA ZOOM VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID #881 7053 7188
*COVID-19 NOTICE*
To protect public health and safety during the local, state, and federally declared COVID-19 emergency, the City Council Chamber and City Hall are closed to the public. Consistent with State of California Executive Orders N-25-20 and N-29-20 and the Los Angeles County Health Officer’s “Safer at Home Order for Control of COVID-19” the City Council will participate in the meeting through teleconference. Public participation in the meeting will be facilitated through the electronic methods as described below.
Agenda Materials:
The agenda and agenda packet related to items on this agenda are available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet will be made available for public inspection at www.cerritos.us.
PUBLIC OBSERVATION AND PARTICIPATION:
The public can observe the meeting via livestream on the City’s website at www.cerritos.us and on Cerritos TV3.
Public Comments:
Members of the public may provide public comment through the following methods:
Email: Members of the public may provide public comment by submitting an email to city_clerk@cerritos.us by 10:00 a.m. on the day of the meeting. Please identify the meeting date and agenda item number for which you would like to provide comment in the subject line of the email. The public comment will be distributed to all members of the City Council. During the meeting your name and summary comments will be read into the record. The document will be retained with the public record of the meeting.
Teleconference Participation: You may provide audio public comment by connecting to the teleconference meeting online or by telephone/mobile call (please select only one method). Public speakers will be queued to provide comment at the appropriate time on the agenda. You must be available to provide comment at the time your connection is “unmuted.” If you are not planning on providing public comment we encourage you to observe the meeting via livestream or on Cerritos TV3 to allow staff to more effectively manage the number of teleconference connections.
Cerritos Zoom meeting online link: https://us02web.zoom.us/j/88170537188
Cerritos Zoom Meeting call-in telephone number: 1 (669) 900-6833
Cerritos Zoom Meeting ID: 881 7053 7188
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Accommodations:
In compliance with the ADA, any person with a disability who requires accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the Office of the City Clerk/Treasurer at (562) 916-1248 to request accommodation. The City will use its best efforts to provide reasonable accommodations related to the teleconference meeting.

MINUTES OF A SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
MONDAY, APRIL 20, 2020, 2:00 P.M., TELECONFERENCE MEETING AUTHORIZED BY
STATE OF CALIFORNIA EXECUTIVE ORDERS N-25-20 AND N-29-20, VIA ZOOM
VIDEO COMMUNICATIONS, MEETING ID# 881 7053 7188

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 2:00 p.m.

2.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The pledge of allegiance was led by Mayor Naresh Solanki.

3.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Grace Hu
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Chuong Vo
  Mayor/Chair Naresh Solanki

  MOTION: It was moved by Vo, and seconded by Hu, to excuse Council/Agency
  Member Edwards from the meeting (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Edwards (excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

4.  Public Comments

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Daisy Lagasca spoke regarding obtaining masks for seniors and inclusion of
  vegetarian meals in the senior meal program.

  Rogan Girard, President of the Cerritos employee union, expressed concerns that
  employees have regarding providing essential services to residents and thanked
  the Council for their support during the COVID-19 emergency.

  Murali Vaseudevan stated that he would like to review agenda materials and
  requested to speak after the presentation of Agenda Item 5A.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor declared
  the public comments period closed.

  (continued on the next page)
 City of Cerritos  April 20, 2020
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 3

5.  New Business

5A.  Review and consideration to reduce the increasing deficit of the Fiscal Year 2019-
  2020 Combined Financial Budget in response to accelerated economic impacts due
  to the COVID-19 emergency (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  Staff reports were given by Art Gallucci, City Manager, Ryan Carey, Finance
  Manager and Jeff Thielke, Budget Manager. A PowerPoint presentation was
  displayed.

  The Mayor opened the public comments period.

  Sam Desai spoke regarding declining revenue, revenue forecasting, and increasing
  other sources of revenue.

  Mark Bollman thanked the City Council and staff for the measures being taken to
  improve sources of revenue.

  Mel Cortez spoke regarding cuts beginning with top-level City employees, if
  staffing reductions are to be made.

  Daisy Lagasca spoke regarding the addition of a donation option for senior meal
  costs and reductions in City Council auto allowances.

  Murali Vasudevan spoke regarding cuts beginning with top-level City employees, if
  staffing reductions are to be made and expense reductions due to services being
  shut down.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor declared
  the public comments period closed.

  City Council and staff discussion ensued regarding various strategies to address
  the increasing deficit of the Fiscal Year 2019-2020 Combined Financial Budget in
  response to accelerated economic impacts due to the COVID-19 emergency. The
  City Council requested that staff provide additional information related to the City’s
  current and future financial position and provide proposals for cost reductions and
  revenue enhancements.

  CONSENSUS: Concurrence was requested by Vo, and seconded by Solanki, to
  suspend the City Councilmember automobile allowance effective immediately.

  The concurrence carried (3 - 0) as follows: Hu, Vo, Solanki. Councilmember
  Edwards was excused absent for this meeting and Councilmember Yokoyama did
  not provide a response to the consensus vote.

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and affirmed unanimously, to adjourn the
  Monday, April 20, 2020, 2:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency special meeting
  to Thursday, April 23, 2020, 7:00 p.m. and hold it concurrently with the Thursday,
  April 23, 2020, 7:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency regular meeting
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (4 - 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Hu, Yokoyama, Vo, Solanki
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  Edwards (Excused)
  ABSTAIN:  None

6.  Adjournment

  The Monday, April 20, 2020, 2:00 p.m. City Council/Successor Agency special
  meeting was adjourned at 3:42 p.m. to Thursday, April 23, 2020, 7:00 p.m. and
  will be held concurrently with the Thursday, April 23, 2020, 7:00 p.m. City
  Council/Successor Agency regular meeting.

  /s/Vida Barone
  Vida Barone, City Clerk/Agency Secretary
